parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of adding a nullable OneToOneField on SQLite by modifying the schema editor to handle this case. The changes are minimal and focused on the problem area.

issues.description: The patch introduces new files for a test project, which is not aligned with the typical Django project structure and conventions.
